description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Switch Draw Mode II (Fire, Dark)], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Sorceress's Knight Mode I (Seifer)] and [Dark/Fire Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Sorceress's Knight Mode I (Seifer)
description.text: Dark/Fire abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Dark and Fire abilities trigger 2 additional times, critical chance =25%/50%/75%/100% for equipped Dark/Fire abilities after casting 1/2/3/4+ Dark/Fire abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Sorceress's Knight Mode II (Seifer)], removes [Dual Awoken Sorceress's Knight Mode I (Seifer)]
